query:
SELECT COALESCE(
                       (SELECT MIN(a.seq)
                          FROM big_repo_keyhive_admissions a
                         WHERE a.scope_id = ?1
                           AND NOT EXISTS (
                               SELECT 1
                                 FROM big_repo_keyhive_event_tombstones t
                                WHERE t.scope_id = a.scope_id
                                  AND t.event_hash = a.event_hash
                           )),
                       (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq), 0) + 1
                          FROM big_repo_keyhive_admissions
                         WHERE scope_id = ?1)
                   ) - 1 AS "floor!: i64"
